operations.stopNotice: Stop new claims on this installation. Work already claimed continues and may start after this change.
operations.resumeNotice: Allow this installation to claim new executions again.
operations.cancelNotice: Cancel only this execution. Other attempts and the original issue are unchanged. Server acceptance does not confirm that the remote process has stopped.
operations.conflict: The target changed or this request conflicts with an earlier operation. Refresh the target before starting another request.
operations.failed: The request was rejected. Review the target and your access before trying again.
operations.uncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Keep this original request and key; check its status or retry the same request.
operations.notRecorded: No receipt is visible yet. The original request may still commit. Check again or retry using this same key.
operations.manual: Status checks run briefly while this page is open. You can refresh at any time; leaving this page does not cancel the operation.
operations.readFailed: Status is unavailable. The last receipt below is retained; refresh to check again.

results.cancelled_before_dispatch: Cancelled before dispatch. No daemon acknowledgement was needed.
results.awaiting_daemon_confirmation: The server cancelled this execution. Waiting for the daemon to confirm that it stopped.
results.confirmation_unavailable: The server cancelled this execution. This runtime cannot provide a managed process confirmation.
results.already_terminal: The execution was already finished. No cancellation was applied to it.
results.already_cancelled_unverified: The execution was already cancelled. Its process state has not been verified.
results.daemon_stopped: The daemon reported that this execution stopped.
results.admission_stopped: The server has stopped new claims. In-flight work continues.
results.admission_accepting: The server permits new claims again.
results.unknown: No recognized completion evidence is available.
results.execution_fence_conflict: The execution changed before cancellation. This request did not cancel it. Refresh the target before starting a new request.

operations.storageFailed: The original request could not be preserved. No new operation was sent. Restore browser storage access and refresh.
